reuse.why: Reuses linkBankSyncAccount, findOrCreateBank, post/BankSyncError and the getServer config pattern, but the take-over path re-writes unlinkAccount's field clearing instead of extracting a shared local-unlink helper, and the guard is not put into the shared linkBankSyncAccount path.

duplication.why: The account-detach update is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount block, downloadFintegraTransactions is a condensed copy of downloadEnableBankingTransactions, and the same guard call is repeated in six provider link functions.

placement.why: Provider pieces sit where the tree puts them (app.ts link handlers, sync.ts downloader, server-config, types), but the link rules live in a helper each provider must remember to call instead of in linkBankSyncAccount, and the closed-account rule is hidden inside a helper named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked.

scope.why: Changes stay on linking, the new provider and their tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Workable, but the guard's name no longer describes what it does (closed check, duplicate check, unlink on replace), a new provider can skip it silently, and unlink semantics now live in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked: detaches the previous account with its own db.updateAccount copy instead of going through the unlinkAccount logic; link rules are applied per provider rather than in linkBankSyncAccount

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions: downloadEnableBankingTransactions reshaped (inlined body/headers, compacted destructuring) rather than shared

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked: gains the replaceExistingLink flag and two special branches (closed-account refusal for upgradingId, detach-on-replace) beyond the duplicate-link check its name describes; all six link handlers call it
